name: researcher-idle
title: Idle loop
prompt:
FOUR frames arranged in a 2-column by 2-row equal-cell grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. One full-body character in each cell. Frame 1 neutral relaxed standing reference pose, orb in belt cradle, hands down, eyes open. Frame 2 inhale: torso and mantle rise only one logical pixel while feet stay planted, hands drift a fraction outward. Frame 3 exhale: torso settles to original height with one brief gentle eye blink, head size unchanged. Frame 4 eyes open, same pose as frame 1, relaxed shoulders. Very subtle loop, not four different poses, head tilts, waving, or bouncing. Both feet remain fixed. Keep all four root anchors identical.

Every frame keeps the SAME elevated front-three-quarter orientation facing screen lower-left. Never turn to a pure profile, mirror halfway through, or face front in one frame. name: researcher-magic
title: Divination effect overlay
prompt:
FOUR frames in a 2-column by 2-row equal square-cell grid, of DIVINATION EFFECTS ONLY. Image 1 supplies the cast character's scale and palette but DO NOT DRAW THE PERSON, orb, hands, clothing or floor. These transparent layers will be placed over the caster. Each cell shares a conceptual 64x64 grid with character root local (32,58) and held-orb center around local (29,33). Around that fixed chest-height orb center draw a modest thin horizontal elliptical amber rune orbit about 18 pixels wide and 7 deep, plus three tiny geometric glyph marks and two very small gold particles. Frame 1 orbit at neutral inclination and glyph arrangement. Frame 2 glyph positions advance one quarter-turn, orbit tilts slightly. Frame 3 advance another quarter-turn with one particle briefly brighter. Frame 4 advance again approaching frame 1. Use crisp pale amber and muted ochre pixel strokes, simple original unreadable geometric marks, not actual words, letters, numbers or religious symbols. Actual alpha everywhere except these sparse strokes; center is empty for the physical orb. No glowing background cloud, bloom, rays, full-body silhouette, feet circle, smoke, fireball, bright solid disk or extra props. All four overlays share exact center, scale and boundaries. This candidate is separate from every character body sheet.

Use the exact reference pixel density and warm amber family. For this effects-only sheet the character identity/pose instructions do not apply: absolutely no character pixels. Layout, shared cell sizes, clean transparent gaps, restrained effect footprint and no labels are mandatory.
